Cloud Access Broker

A security policy enforcement point between cloud service users and providers that ensures enterprise security requirements, such as access controls, compliance, and data protection, are applied to cloud resources.

Questions and answers

What is Cloud Access Broker?

In this glossary, Cloud Access Broker refers to: A security policy enforcement point between cloud service users and providers that ensures enterprise security requirements, such as access controls, compliance, and data protection, are applied to cloud resources.

How is Cloud Access Broker used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Setzen Sie einen Cloud Access Broker ein, um DLP- und starke Authentifizierungsrichtlinien für alle von Remote-Mitarbeitern genutzten SaaS-Anwendungen durchzusetzen."

Definition

A security policy enforcement point between cloud service users and providers that ensures enterprise security requirements, such as access controls, compliance, and data protection, are applied to cloud resources.

Operational example

Deploy a cloud access broker to enforce DLP and strong authentication policies for all SaaS applications accessed by remote employees.
